_comment: RRR (real-result-or-it-didn't-happen) classification matrix. Each surface gets a tier and the MAX honest landed it may claim. score.py --rrr fails when a finding's metadata.landed outranks its surface's max — i.e. a detection fixture must never emit a credential-gate or state-change claim. Findings without a module:action (vulncheck template matches, fingerprints) are detection results scored via coverage/service-inventory and are excluded from this check. Surfaces not listed are 'uncovered' (a classification gap), not failed; --rrr-require-covered also fails on any uncovered. Tiers: detection->reachable, influence->influenced, credential-gate->read-confirmed, state-change->execution-confirmed. Ranks mirror internal/enrichment LandedRank. Inference-server execution is gated by input-dependent output: canned /predict responses stay reachable, while route-specific verified inference can earn execution-confirmed.
